Wang's thesis adds a Bell-type null on meaning judgements. | [CASE-359](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-359.md) | A check of signalling estimators, a guaranteed interval and an exact no-signalling test for binary Contextuality-by-Default systems, by enumeration and simulation, applied to the three binary systems a corpus study of ambiguous phrases prints as fractions | Run in session for [LEAD-072](../../../record/leads.d/LEAD-072.md) on 2026-11-22 (scratch/studies/lead-072; sig.py with 9 passing tests, exact.py, mc.py, floor.py, apply.py; seeds fixed). Exact enumeration per content and 4,000-replication simulations of correlated rank-2 systems at 2 to 100 occurrences a context. The plug-in Δ's bias at zero signalling is 1.5 at two occurrences and 0.22 at a hundred; the root of the unbiased squared difference cuts it by half or more and falls short at large Δ. The simultaneous Clopper-Pearson interval never covered below 0.999; Newcombe's approximate one fell to 0.93. The Bonferroni-Fisher test kept its size (at most 0.034 at 5%) and cannot reject at all below three occurrences. On [LIT-842](../../../record/literature.d/LIT-842.md)'s printed systems, at the least counts their fractions allow, one signals by the interval, one by the test alone, one by neither; a fourth table is inconsistent as printed. [LIT-851](../../../record/literature.d/LIT-851.md) could not be used. The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Proposed |
